stopPoints.label: Peppa introduces Daddy Pig
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'Look at Daddy Pig! What color are his round glasses?'
Options: 'A) Black 👓 B) Pink 🌸'
Guidance: Guide the child to say: 'They are black!'

stopPoints.label: Going to the beach
stopPoints.question:
Question (Location): 'Where is Peppa's family going today?'
Guidance: Model the sentence: 'They are going to the beach! 🏖️'

stopPoints.label: Unpacking beach items
stopPoints.question:
Question (Vocabulary): 'Mummy Pig has buckets and what?'
Options: 'A) Spades 🥄 B) Pencils ✏️'
Guidance: Guide the child: 'Buckets and spades!'

stopPoints.label: Putting on sun cream
stopPoints.question:
Question (Reason): 'Why do they need sun cream?'
Guidance: Prompt the child: 'Because the sun is very hot! ☀️'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig tests the ball
stopPoints.question:
Question (Pattern): 'Look at the ball! Does it have spots or stripes?'
Guidance: Encourage the child: 'It is a spotty ball! 🔴'

stopPoints.label: George tries to catch the ball
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Can George catch the ball?'
Options: 'A) Yes, he can. B) No, he cannot.'
Guidance: Say: 'No, he is too little!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy invites them to paddle
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'Where are Peppa and George going to paddle?'
Guidance: Prompt the child: 'In the sea! 🌊'

stopPoints.label: George puts on water wings
stopPoints.question:
Question (Color): 'Look at George's arms. What color are his water wings?'
Options: 'A) Yellow 🟡 B) Blue 🔵'
Guidance: Encourage the child to answer: 'They are yellow!'

stopPoints.label: Ready to swim
stopPoints.question:
Question (Ready): 'Peppa and George have their water wings on. Are they ready to swim?'
Guidance: Encourage the child: 'Yes, they are ready!'

stopPoints.label: Stepping into the water
stopPoints.question:
Question (Feeling): 'Is the sea water cold or warm?'
Guidance: Elicit the line: 'It is lovely and warm!'

stopPoints.label: Splashing Daddy Pig
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'What are they doing in the water?'
Guidance: Say: 'They are splashing water! Splash! Splash! 💦'

stopPoints.label: Buckets and spades
stopPoints.question:
Question (Play): 'What do Peppa and George want to play with on the sand?'
Guidance: Prompt the child: 'Buckets and spades! 🪣'

stopPoints.label: Asking Daddy politely
stopPoints.question:
Question (Polite Manners): 'Peppa asks Daddy to bury him. What polite word does she say?'
Guidance: Guide the child: 'Please! She says, "Please, Daddy!"'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig buried in sand
stopPoints.question:
Question (Body Parts): 'Daddy is covered in sand! Which part of Daddy can you still see?'
Guidance: Ask the child to touch their own head and say: 'His head!'

stopPoints.label: Straw hat for Daddy
stopPoints.question:
Question (Clothing): 'Daddy's head is hot. What kind of hat does he want?'
Options: 'A) A straw hat 👒 B) A winter hat ❄️'
Guidance: Guide the child: 'A straw hat!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig falls asleep
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Daddy Pig is snoring! Is he sleeping?'
Options: 'A) Yes, he is. B) No, he isn't.'
Guidance: Say: 'Yes, he is having a little sleep! Shh... 😴'

stopPoints.label: First sandcastle
stopPoints.question:
Question (Magic Word): 'When the sandcastle is made, what fun word does Peppa say?'
Guidance: Encourage the child: 'Hey presto! ✨'

stopPoints.label: Two sandcastles
stopPoints.question:
Question (Count): 'Let's count together! How many sandcastles are there?'
Guidance: Count together: 'One, two! Two sandcastles! 🏰🏰'

stopPoints.label: Packing up
stopPoints.question:
Question (Routine): 'Mummy Pig packed the towels and bags. Is it play time or home time?'
Guidance: Guide the child: 'It is home time! 🚗'

stopPoints.label: Who is under the hat?
stopPoints.question:
Question (Humor): 'Mummy thinks they forgot the hat. But who is sleeping under the hat?'
Guidance: Prompt with a laugh: 'Daddy Pig! They forgot Daddy Pig! 🐷'
